name: Playlist Maker
description: Build playlists quickly with live genre/artist based recommendations, similar to Spotify or Apple Music.
overview: Adds a Playlist Maker page to Jellyfin's sidebar with a fast search + drag-free playlist builder and a live 'more like this' recommendations panel driven by genre and artist matching.

versions.changelog:
## v1.0.0.0
- Initial release.
- Sidebar "Playlist Maker" page: search your library, pick genre/artist chips, and build a playlist.
- Live "Recommended For You" panel that scores your library by genre/artist overlap with the current draft.
- Cold-start fallback surfaces popular/recently added tracks when nothing has been picked yet.
